title: Andaman pensioners hold mass dharnas over 8th CPC pension revision exclusion
seoTitle: Port Blair pensioners protest exclusion from CPC

tea.why: Pensioners protested against the exclusion of pension revision from the Terms of Reference of the 8th Central Pay Commission.
tea.want: They demanded the inclusion of pension revision under the 8th CPC and opposed moves to divide retirees by retirement dates.
tea.changed: Nov 25: The Government Pensioners’ Association held mass dharnas in Sri Vijaya Puram and Rangat in solidarity with a national protest.

summary: Pensioners in the Andaman and Nicobar Islands held mass dharnas in Sri Vijaya Puram and Rangat to protest the exclusion of pension revision from the 8th Central Pay Commission. Organised by the Government Pensioners’ Association, the demonstrations were held in solidarity with a nationwide protest called by the Forum of Civil Pensioners’ Associations in New Delhi. Speakers at the protests criticised government measures in the Finance Bill 2025 intended to differentiate retirees by their retirement dates. Association leaders stated that neither the Central Government nor the 8th CPC was willing to discuss pensioners' grievances. No official response from the administration was reported in the sources.
organizers: Government Pensioners’ Association, Andaman and Nicobar Islands
